markdown_content: ## Overview of the New Library in CLO 2025.0 This section explains the location, layout, and purpose of the redesigned library interface in CLO 2025.0, focusing on how it enhances workspace efficiency with features like a pop-up design, keyboard shortcuts, and screen space optimization. The new library in CLO 2025.0 is accessed via a three-line icon located at the top right of the screen or by using the shortcut key **Y**. It opens as a pop-up window, designed to maximize the available screen space for 2D and 3D viewports, especially beneficial for users with smaller screens. Users can revert to the old library interface by clicking a back button and confirming the switch. Likewise, switching back to the new library is possible from the bottom of the old library menu, with options to try it immediately or access a manual for guidance. The pop-up library remembers its last screen position, which is especially useful for multi-monitor setups. A **reset layout** button is available at the bottom right of the library to reposition the window to a default location if it becomes lost or misplaced. The library can be opened or closed using the icon or shortcut **Y**, and it also features an exit button to close it. --- ## Library Layout and Navigation This section details the structural organization of the new library, including library categories, folder breakdowns, navigation aids, and view customization options. At the top of the library window, users can switch between multiple libraries: - **CLO**: Contains all default CLO assets such as garments, avatars, fabrics, trims, and stages. - **CLOSET**: CLO’s cloud-based asset management platform. - **User Libraries**: Custom libraries added by the user, which can include any folders imported from the desktop. On the far left, the library displays a folder tree representing the contents of the selected library, allowing users to browse subfolders, workspaces, and favorites. For example, within a user library, folders such as "key features" or other categorized assets are visible. The second level of the top bar allows switching between asset types within the CLO library, such as toggling between **CLO assets** and **Connect assets**. The third level shows the current navigation path within the library, indicating the user’s location (e.g., “garments” or “hangers”). Additional controls include: - **View Mode**: Users can customize how assets are displayed (icon view, detailed view, preview panel). - **Size Lineup Info**: Users can save custom viewing preferences, which persist between sessions. - **Refresh Button**: Refreshes the contents of the library to reflect any external changes. - **Back Button**: Returns users to the previous library interface if desired. --- ## Managing Libraries and Favorites This section describes procedures for organizing libraries, managing favorite folders, and customizing library contents. Users can bring in multiple libraries by clicking the **Add** button and selecting folders from their computer. These libraries appear under the user’s own libraries tab and can be renamed or deleted via right-click context menus. Favorites from the old library can be transferred into the new library, maintaining user workflows. Favorites appear as a dedicated folder within the library for quick access. Right-click options include: - **Rename**: Change the name of any library or folder. - **Delete**: Remove unwanted libraries or folders. - **Add to Workspace**: Quickly add assets or folders to the current workspace for easy access. Users can freely organize folders and libraries to suit their workflow needs. --- ## Accessing CLO and Connect Assets This section covers the integration of CLO’s core assets and Connect assets within the new library, including search, download, and sorting functionality. The CLO library contains core assets such as garments, avatars, fabrics, trims, and stages. Users can switch between CLO’s native assets and **Connect assets**—assets available from CLO’s online platform—with a toggle. Key features: - **Search Bar**: Search within any library for specific asset names, e.g., “skirt” or “jacket.” - **Download Management**: New assets are marked as "new" and can be bulk selected via checkboxes with a "check all" option to download multiple assets simultaneously. - **Sorting Options**: Assets can be sorted by name, last modified date, size, or type in ascending or descending order. - **View Modes**: Users can switch between icons, detailed lists, or preview panels showing front, back, and side views of garments or drape information for fabrics. - **Drag and Drop**: Assets can be dragged from the library directly into the 3D workspace, facilitating quick scene assembly. - **Download Control**: Users can pause or stop downloads if needed. --- ## Using the Library for Workflow Efficiency This section explains practical ways to incorporate the new library into live workflows, including importing CLOSET files, managing versions, and building scenes. Users can import CLOSET files directly into the workspace by dragging and dropping from the library. Right-clicking on a CLOSET file offers options such as: - **Add to Workspace**: Adds the asset or file to the current workspace. - **Copy Path**: Copies the file path for reference. - **Show in Explorer**: Opens the file location in the OS file explorer. - **Open Previous Versions**: Allows access to older versions of a file, if available. - **Open with CLOSET**: Opens the asset directly in the CLOSET platform. Once assets are imported, users can rearrange and organize them within their workspace. The library keeps track of the current asset version, but users can switch to previous versions if necessary. The library also supports adding assets from the user’s computer or from the Connect store, such as shoes or stages, expanding creative flexibility. --- ## Integration with CLO Virtual Fashion Platforms This section highlights the seamless connectivity between the new library and other CLO virtual fashion platforms, emphasizing ease of scene creation and asset management. The new library unifies multiple CLO platforms—CLO core assets, CLOSET cloud assets, Connect online store, and user libraries—into a single interface. This integration allows designers to quickly assemble complex scenes by combining garments, avatars, fabrics, trims, shoes, and stages with minimal effort. Users can access the Connect website directly from the library interface for browsing and acquiring new assets. Drag-and-drop functionality extends across these platforms, simplifying the import process. This streamlined workflow reduces time spent on asset management, enabling faster iteration and creative exploration within the CLO 3D environment. --- ## Summary The CLO 2025.0 library overhaul introduces a flexible, pop-up interface accessible via the top-right icon or shortcut **Y**, prioritizing screen space for 2D and 3D views. It includes multi-library support (CLO, CLOSET, user libraries), streamlined navigation, customizable views, and enhanced asset management features such as favorites transfer, folder organization, and version control. Integration with CLO’s Connect platform and drag-and-drop support enable rapid scene building, while the ability to manage downloads and asset previews improves productivity. Overall, the new library significantly enhances the CLO user experience by consolidating assets and platforms into a cohesive, efficient workspace tool.
